name: Sony MDR-7506 (AutoEq average measurement EQ, same L/R curve)
target: AutoEq Harman over-ear target; FIR normalized to 0 dB at 1 kHz
channelClaim: The same average-measurement EQ is applied to L/R; not independent L/R calibration and does not correct unit channel mismatch.
derivation: scripts/build-sony-mdr-7506-average-profile.mjs synthesized the published 10-band PEQ at 48 kHz into 8192 taps and normalized it at 1 kHz. AutoEq's -4.1 dB preamp is intentionally excluded.
deviceRevision: Sony MDR-7506 as identified by AutoEq Super Review
playbackState: Passive wired headphone; source measurement state is defined by AutoEq Super Review
measurementRig: Super Review measurement data as processed by AutoEq
